description:
Why: in ProductMemo's commit path (src/compiler2/pull.rs, the prepare loop of the commit) two values exist only to fill a shape. (1) std::mem::take(&mut dependencies.membership) moves the membership set onto the ProductEntry and leaves an always-empty membership field inside the Rc<ProductDependencies> that the entry keeps: every stored ProductDependencies has a field that says nothing. (2) previous.map(|entry| entry.membership).unwrap_or_default() invents an empty set for a product that was never committed, so replace_membership_readers and committed_rooted_member (pull/rooted.rs) cannot tell 'never committed' from 'committed with no members'.

What: ProductDependencies has no membership field; the computation returns membership beside the dependencies and the entry is its only home. The previous membership is passed as Option<&..>; the two readers handle None directly.

Signal: no behaviour change. Identity on the five probes (interp/run stdout, canonical backend dump, activation key and job counts); no pin movement; instructions within noise or lower. Neither value allocates today (an empty HashSet has no heap storage), so this is a data-model fix, not a speed claim.

Order: after fz-53f.2 (same engine files). Removes: the membership field of ProductDependencies, the mem::take, the unwrap_or_default.
title: A product's membership lives on its entry, and a first commit has no previous membership
